preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_log_event_type WHERE audit_log_event_type_id = 150;

changeSet.author: muw
changeSet.sql: WITH last_commit AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (a.entity_id) a.entity_id AS event_crf_id, a.entity_name, a.audit_date FROM audit_log_event a WHERE a.audit_table = 'event_crf' AND a.audit_log_event_type_id = 110 ORDER BY a.entity_id, a.audit_date DESC, a.audit_id DESC ), restored AS ( UPDATE event_crf ec SET date_validate_completed = lc.audit_date FROM last_commit lc WHERE lc.event_crf_id = ec.event_crf_id AND lc.entity_name = 'date_validate_completed' AND ec.date_validate_completed IS NULL AND ec.date_completed IS NOT NULL AND ec.date_completed <= lc.audit_date AND ec.status_id NOT IN (5, 6, 7) RETURNING ec.event_crf_id, ec.study_event_id, ec.date_validate_completed ) INSERT INTO audit_log_event (audit_log_event_type_id, audit_date, user_id, audit_table, entity_id, entity_name, old_value, new_value, reason_for_change, study_event_id) SELECT 150, now(), NULL, 'event_crf', r.event_crf_id, 'date_validate_completed', '', to_char(r.date_validate_completed, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'Restored from the record of the clean second pass, whose date the pass ' || 'itself cleared (fixed in 1.5.0-beta.16-muw)', r.study_event_id FROM restored r

rollback.sql: UPDATE event_crf SET date_validate_completed = NULL WHERE event_crf_id IN (SELECT entity_id FROM audit_log_event WHERE audit_log_event_type_id = 150 AND audit_table = 'event_crf'); DELETE FROM audit_log_event WHERE audit_log_event_type_id = 150
